prompt:
Our hardware team is developing a 5G NR smartphone and needs to evaluate Maxscend components for the receive chain. The target bands are n77 and n78 (3.3–4.2 GHz). We have a requirements file at `project/system/specs/rx_chain_requirements.csv` and a prototype test log at `project/rf_design/test_data/proto_v2_test_log.txt`.

Please produce a complete technical feasibility report saved as `feasibility_report.json` in the workspace. The report must include:
1. The recommended Maxscend component models for the antenna switch, LNA, and band filter that best match our band and performance requirements.
2. A calculated cascade noise figure (in dB) for the full receive chain using the actual spec values of the selected components.
3. Whether the selected chain meets the 3.5 dB NF budget (true/false).
4. A fault diagnosis section explaining why the prototype's noise figure is failing and listing the specific corrective actions to investigate, based on the symptoms in the test log.

The FAE support team from Maxscend will review this report, so it must be technically precise and reference the correct component parameters.
